verdict.rationale: Solid's own docs highlight full SSR/serverless, streaming, and data-loading (Resources/Suspense) capabilities that underpin its official meta-framework (SolidStart) for routing and data fetching, but hands-on community feedback specifically flags SolidStart's routing as 'occasionally very slow, no workaround, no support,' directly contradicting a smooth full-stack routing/data experience. Missing for 10: first-party SolidStart documentation/examples in the pack, and corroborating evidence that routing issues have been resolved.
